subject: Fragile redeployments: people-first rebalance & manager support
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amy Singh <amy.singh@peopleops-consult.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Fragile redeployments: people-first rebalance & manager support

Team —

I've attached the initial impact matrix for the proposed cross-team rebalance we discussed in leadership last week (reorg-impact-matrix.xlsx). This is intentionally narrow: it focuses on role scope changes and recommended care paths for impacted ICs rather than org names. High level: we are planning a capacity-driven consolidation across two small infra-facing pods with the goal of reducing duplicate ownership of the serving runtime and aligning on a single compute-product owner.

As discussed, priority items for this thread:
- Confirm the manager-led care path (3-step: 1: one-on-one + role options; 2: transition support; 3: follow-up review)
- Validate timing relative to the Q1 performance review window (we need to avoid overlapping deliverables and notice periods)
- Agree on comms cadence and owner for the initial all-hands and follow-up 1:1 templates (I attached a draft comm-draft-email.txt and manager FAQ manager-support-FAQ.docx)

Key constraints to keep in mind:
- We want to keep any headcount action as voluntary redeployments where possible; involuntary steps are last-resort.
- Any notice or severance must follow the standard legal template Amy advised on last quarter. Amy — please flag any legal constraints up front.

Timeline proposal:
- Jan 12–14: leadership alignment and finalize care path scripts
- Jan 15–22: manager outreach to affected ICs (private 1:1s)
- Jan 26: public comm to broader product & infra organizations

Please respond with 1) redline suggestions to the matrix, 2) any blockers you see for the timeline, and 3) whether you can take on manager support draft ownership.

Thanks,
Priyom
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Amy Singh <amy.singh@peopleops-consult.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fragile redeployments: people-first rebalance & manager support

Thanks for the clear framing, Priyom. I reviewed the impact matrix and left comments on two rows where role scope overlaps are more significant than the sheet indicates (lines for "runtime cache ownership" and "compile-to-kernel").

A few things I want to call out:
- Performance reviews: We can't start manager outreach to affected ICs before review calibration completes on Jan 20; some of the scope changes impact ranking/context. If managers talk about role moves earlier, we risk mixed signals.
- Compensation & severance: If we end up with involuntary reductions, I want us to pre-clear severance bands with Finance. Monica — can you loop Finance (invoice@redwood.ai) if this becomes likely?
- Manager support: I can own the manager FAQ and 1:1 script, but I need Monica to vet the legal language and Amy to sign off on the notice wording.

Suggested tweak to timeline: move manager 1:1s to Jan 21–28, public comm Jan 29. That gives us a week post-calibration.

Also, small ask — let's make the manager scripts explicit about signposting for internal redeploy opportunities and reasonable timelines for decisions (no more than 3 weeks from first 1:1).

—Marissa
VP, Eng Productivity

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Amy Singh <amy.singh@peopleops-consult.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 13:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fragile redeployments: people-first rebalance & manager support

Thanks — I reviewed the attached manager FAQ. High level notes:
1) Legal & compliance: Amy, the template looks fine but two items to confirm: a) whether we must offer the standard 60-day notice vs. pay-in-lieu in our region; b) whether there are any required local council notifications for EU contractors if we touch those populations.
2) Finance: I'm looping Finance offline and will confirm estimated severance / redeployment training budget by EOD Jan 14. If we keep to voluntary redeployments it will materially reduce cost.
3) Communication draft: I pushed a lighter public comm variant to the draft that emphasizes internal mobility and manager availability.

Operationally I volunteer to own the manager training session (30–45 min live workshop + recording). Marissa, I'll collaborate with you on the 1:1 script edits. Priyom, I can produce a short checklist for managers to run through during the private 1:1s.

Monica
Head of People Ops (Interim)

From: Amy Singh <amy.singh@peopleops-consult.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fragile redeployments: people-first rebalance & manager support

Thanks for the ping. A few legal flags: 
- Notice / severance: for US W-2 employees, pay-in-lieu of notice is acceptable; for EU registrants we need to check country-level mandatory notice or consult local counsel. If contractors are impacted, contracts must be reviewed for termination clauses.
- Documentation: please capture a written record of every manager 1:1 and a minimal fact template (who, date, options discussed). This will protect us for claim risk later.
- Timing: avoid any public or group-level comms before Jan 21 (calibration complete) — managers may have to alter performance narratives post-calibration.

I can provide a redlined legal appendix for the manager FAQ by EOD Jan 14. Let me know which locales are in scope for this wave and I'll prioritize.

—Amy
Employment Counsel (PeopleOps Consulting)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amy Singh <amy.singh@peopleops-consult.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 17:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fragile redeployments: people-first rebalance & manager support

We've converged in the leadership sync this afternoon: summary and agreed next actions below. Sharing here so we have a single source of truth.

Summary decisions:
- Timeline: manager 1:1s will run Jan 21–27 (per Marissa's calibration request). Public comm to product & infra on Jan 29.
- Manager ownership: Marissa to own 1:1 script and FAQ; Monica to deliver manager training on Jan 20 (recording available). Amy to provide legal appendix by Jan 14.
- Care path: three options for affected ICs — 1) internal redeploy; 2) supported exit with notice/severance; 3) temporary shadowing + skills ramp to eligible roles. Decisions on option must be made within 3 weeks of first 1:1.
- Documentation: managers must complete the minimal fact template after each 1:1 (template attached to shared drive link).

Open items and owners:
- Finance confirmation of severance bands (Monica) — due Jan 14 EOD.
- Local counsel check for EU contractors (Amy) — due Jan 14 EOD.
- Final redlines to the impact matrix (Karthik & Marissa) — due Jan 14 noon.

If no material blockers are raised by EOD Jan 14, we'll lock the manager scripts and schedule the Jan 20 training. If blockers arise, we'll reconvene Jan 15 10:00 PT for a final decision.

Thanks, everyone — we owe the team clear, consistent and compassionate execution here.

Neha Kapoor
VP, People & Org
Redwood Inference
